trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Method: 1) Start a new game and play the opening sequence. 2) Gone Fishing is the first story mission - follow its markers to the end. 3) The trophy pops as the mission completes; there is no fail state that can lock it. Requirements: None - it is the story opener and cannot be skipped. Effort: Under an hour into the game. Basis: official description per Exophase (PSN data), list cross-checked on XCT.live and TrueAchievements.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Method: 1) Keep following the story markers after Gone Fishing. 2) Work through every Chapter 1 mission in order - the chapter ends with a set-piece finale. 3) The trophy pops on the chapter-complete screen. Requirements: Story progression only; no side content is needed. Effort: The first few hours of the campaign. Basis: official description per Exophase (PSN data), list cross-checked on XCT.live and TrueAchievements.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Method: 1) Continue the story into Chapter 2, where the money side of the plot opens up. 2) Finish every Chapter 2 mission in order. 3) The trophy pops when the chapter closes. The asterisks are part of the platform name itself - both console stores serve it censored, and this guide prints it the way the trophy list does. Requirements: Chapter 1 completed. Effort: A few more hours of story play. Basis: official description per Exophase (PSN data), name as served by PSN and Xbox, cross-checked on XCT.live.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Method: 1) Play through Chapter 3's mission chain in order. 2) The chapter leans into Vice City itself - expect the map to open up as you go. 3) The trophy pops on the chapter-complete screen. Requirements: Chapter 2 completed. Effort: Mid-campaign, several hours in. Basis: official description per Exophase (PSN data), list cross-checked on XCT.live and TrueAchievements.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Method: 1) Play through Chapter 4, the last full chapter before the finale. 2) Finish every mission in the chain - the trophy pops as the chapter closes and the endgame unlocks. Requirements: Chapter 3 completed. Effort: Late campaign. Basis: official description per Exophase (PSN data), platform casing of the name as served on XCT.live and TrueAchievements.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Method: 1) Finish Chapter 4 to unlock the final mission. 2) Stock up before you start it - the finale is a long, combat-heavy run. 3) Play it to the credits; the gold pops as the final mission completes. Nothing earlier in the story can lock this trophy, and the free roam continues afterwards, so every other trophy stays available. Requirements: The full story chain through Chapter 4. Effort: The campaign's finishing stretch. Basis: official description per Exophase (PSN data), list cross-checked on XCT.live and TrueAchievements.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Method: 1) Breakfast Run arrives early in the story rotation - take it when the marker appears. 2) Run the errand chain exactly as briefed and bring the delivery home. 3) The trophy pops on mission complete. Requirements: Early story progression. Effort: One short mission. Basis: official description per Exophase (PSN data), list cross-checked on XCT.live and TrueAchievements.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Method: 1) The Cartel Heist is a story heist - work through its setup missions when they appear. 2) On the heist itself, stick to the plan your crew briefs: entry, the take, then a clean escape. 3) The trophy pops when the heist completes, whichever approach the story gave you. Requirements: Mid-story progression; the setups are mandatory story beats. Effort: One heist plus its setups. Basis: official description per Exophase (PSN data), list cross-checked on XCT.live and TrueAchievements.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Method: 1) Child's Play appears in the story rotation during the middle chapters. 2) Play the mission through - it is a character piece rather than a combat test. 3) The trophy pops on mission complete. Requirements: Story progression into the middle chapters. Effort: One mission. Basis: official description per Exophase (PSN data), list cross-checked on XCT.live and TrueAchievements.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Method: 1) Headliners joins the story rotation in the middle chapters. 2) Play the mission to its end - the name is printed in all caps on the platform list, and so is it here. 3) The trophy pops on mission complete. Requirements: Story progression into the middle chapters. Effort: One mission. Basis: official description per Exophase (PSN data), list cross-checked on XCT.live and TrueAchievements.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Method: 1) VCIA Takedown is a late-story mission set around Vice City International Airport. 2) Play it through when the marker appears in the Chapter 4 run. 3) The trophy pops on mission complete. Requirements: Late story progression. Effort: One mission. Basis: official description per Exophase (PSN data), list cross-checked on XCT.live and TrueAchievements.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Method: 1) Operation Savage Glory is one of the last big story operations. 2) Go in stocked - it is a sustained firefight rather than a stealth piece. 3) The trophy pops on mission complete. Requirements: Late story progression. Effort: One long mission. Basis: official description per Exophase (PSN data), list cross-checked on XCT.live and TrueAchievements.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Method: 1) Finish the story first - chapters, named missions and every stranger strand. 2) Clear the activity layer: races, ranges, challenges and the one-of-each activity trophy. 3) Sweep the collectible layer: card sets, WAiNK locations, vehicle discoveries, areas and garage properties. 4) Use the in-game completion checklist as the ledger and work whatever percentage is left; this tracker mirrors the same buckets so the two never disagree for long. The long poles are the collectible sweeps and the 100% checklist's tail, not the story. Requirements: Effectively the whole game - every other strand in this guide feeds it. Effort: The big one - plan on a full completion playthrough, not a weekend. Basis: completion structure per PowerPyx's roadmap; official description per Exophase (PSN data).

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Method: 1) Stunt jumps are scattered across Leonida - ramps, rooftops and half-finished roadworks all count when you land them clean. 2) Work district by district and keep a fast, durable car or bike as your stunt vehicle. 3) A stunt only banks on a clean landing, so reset and retry rather than counting a crash. The counter is generous in total - 250 sounds steep, but stunt spots respawn and repeat attempts are allowed. Requirements: A vehicle and the open map; spots unlock as areas open. Effort: Several hours of deliberate stunt hunting, less if you hit every ramp you pass from the start. Basis: official description per Exophase (PSN data), list cross-checked on XCT.live and TrueAchievements.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Method: 1) There are 9 activity types on the map - races, drone races, the shooting range, fishing, arcade games, bowling and their kin. 2) Start one of each; you only have to try it, not win it. 3) The trophy pops when the last untouched type has been started. Use the map's activity filter and tick the types off - this is the natural first trophy of the activity layer. Requirements: Access to the open map; some types appear as the story opens new areas. Effort: An hour or two of map touring. Basis: official description per Exophase (PSN data), list cross-checked on XCT.live and TrueAchievements.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Method: 1) The Shooting Range runs 42 challenges across the weapon classes. 2) Learn each challenge's target pattern at bronze pace first, then chase gold - accuracy beats speed on almost every board. 3) Golds are per challenge and permanent, so work the list in any order and revisit stubborn ones with a better weapon. Requirements: Shooting Range access; later challenges unlock with weapon classes. Effort: A focused evening or two - the last few golds are the skill check of the activity layer. Basis: official description per Exophase (PSN data), list cross-checked on XCT.live and TrueAchievements.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Method: 1) Top Fun drone races run at 14 locations around the state. 2) You must win, not just finish - learn each course's line with a practice run, then race it properly. 3) Wins are tracked per location, so tour the map and clear them in geographic order. Requirements: Drone race markers unlocked as areas open. Effort: A few hours across all 14 courses. Basis: official description per Exophase (PSN data), list cross-checked on XCT.live and TrueAchievements.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Method: 1) Enter street races across Leonida and win 20 different ones - repeats of the same race do not add to the count. 2) Bring a tuned car in the right class; the AI is beatable with clean lines rather than the fastest top speed. 3) Mix race types as you tour - this pairs naturally with the Top Fun and stunt sweeps. Requirements: Race markers and a competitive vehicle. Effort: A few hours of racing. Basis: official description per Exophase (PSN data), list cross-checked on XCT.live and TrueAchievements.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Method: 1) Find Cal at his fishing spot and accept the challenge. 2) Fish the round out - the win is on the challenge's own scoring, so steady catches beat one lucky monster. 3) If you lose, re-challenge him straight away; nothing locks. Requirements: Fishing unlocked; Cal met in free roam. Effort: One challenge, plus retries if the fish are unkind. Basis: official description per Exophase (PSN data), list cross-checked on XCT.live and TrueAchievements.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Method: 1) Walk up to any arcade cabinet in Leonida's arcades and bars. 2) Play the game through to completion - a full run, not just a credit. 3) The trophy pops when the game ends. Pick the shortest cabinet game you find; they are not all the same length. Requirements: An arcade cabinet; a few in-game dollars for credits. Effort: Minutes. Basis: official description per Exophase (PSN data), list cross-checked on XCT.live and TrueAchievements.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Method: 1) Take Andy's missions whenever his marker appears - his strand runs in stages across the map. 2) Finish the strand's final mission when it unlocks. 3) The trophy pops on that last completion. Strands can sit dormant between stages; if Andy goes quiet, advance the story and check the map again. Requirements: Andy's strand started and its earlier stages done. Effort: One strand of side missions. Basis: official description per Exophase (PSN data), list cross-checked on XCT.live and TrueAchievements.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Method: 1) Work Kenton's mission strand as its markers appear - expect the water to be involved. 2) Finish the strand's final mission when it unlocks. 3) The trophy pops on that completion. Requirements: Kenton's strand started and its earlier stages done. Effort: One strand of side missions. Basis: official description per Exophase (PSN data), list cross-checked on XCT.live and TrueAchievements.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Method: 1) Take Billy's missions as they surface - his strand is a loner's route across the state. 2) Finish the final mission of the strand when it unlocks. 3) The trophy pops on that completion. Requirements: Billy's strand started and its earlier stages done. Effort: One strand of side missions. Basis: official description per Exophase (PSN data), list cross-checked on XCT.live and TrueAchievements.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Method: 1) Stranger strands are the named side stories - Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone, Bret and more - each a chain of missions for one character. 2) A strand only counts when its final mission is done, so finish what you start rather than opening all of them at once. 3) Any 8 completed strands bank the silver; the named strand trophies in this step are five of the easiest eight. Requirements: Strangers met in free roam; strands unlock as the map and story open. Effort: The whole of step 4 is built around this - several hours of side stories. Basis: official description per Exophase (PSN data), list cross-checked on XCT.live and TrueAchievements.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Method: 1) Work Randy's strand as its markers appear - his business is moving product, and the missions follow the money. 2) Finish the strand's final mission when it unlocks. 3) The trophy pops on that completion. Requirements: Randy's strand started and its earlier stages done. Effort: One strand of side missions. Basis: official description per Exophase (PSN data), list cross-checked on XCT.live and TrueAchievements.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Method: 1) Take Tyrone's missions as they appear and see the strand through its stages. 2) Finish the final mission when it unlocks - and yes, the platform list really does capitalise the On. 3) The trophy pops on that completion. Requirements: Tyrone's strand started and its earlier stages done. Effort: One strand of side missions. Basis: official description per Exophase (PSN data), list cross-checked on XCT.live and TrueAchievements.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.missable_note: The one missable watch: PowerPyx flags the meditation spots as under investigation - spots tied to Chapter 1 areas may not be reachable once the story moves on. Meditate at every spot the first time you reach it.
trophies.guide: Method: 1) There are 18 meditation spots across Leonida - marked, quiet places with a prompt to meditate. 2) Meditate at every spot the first time you reach it, starting with the Chapter 1 spots in step 1 of the roadmap. 3) Keep a running count in this tracker; the trophy pops at the 18th spot. Play it safe: Treat every early spot as now-or-never - do the Chapter 1 spots before finishing the chapter, and never drive past a spot marker promising to come back. What confirms it: Whether the spots stay reachable after their chapters close is exactly what is under investigation; if a missed spot turns out to be permanent, the watch warning here was the right call, and a fresh playthrough is the recovery. Requirements: Map access as each area opens; no other trophy gates the spots themselves. Effort: Minutes per spot, spread across the whole playthrough - the cost is attention, not time. Basis: the missable watch per PowerPyx (status under investigation at launch); official description per Exophase (PSN data).

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Method: 1) Bret's strand is the hunting line - take his missions as they appear. 2) The trophy's hunt is a unique animal: track it the way Bret briefs, not the way regular hunting works. 3) The trophy pops when the unique animal is taken and the mission closes. Requirements: Bret's strand started; hunting gear helps. Effort: One strand, ending in one special hunt. Basis: official description per Exophase (PSN data), list cross-checked on XCT.live and TrueAchievements.

trophies.name: Don’t Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Method: 1) Collectible Cards are hidden across Leonida in themed sets. 2) Complete any 3 full sets - a set only counts when its last card is picked up. 3) Sweep district by district and use this tracker to see which sets are nearly done before hunting single stragglers. Requirements: Open-map access; some cards sit in late-story areas. Effort: A long sweep - cards are small, numerous and easy to walk past. Basis: official description per Exophase (PSN data), name printed with the platform's typographic apostrophe, list cross-checked on XCT.live.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Method: 1) WAiNK spots are marked interaction locations all over the state - the trophy wants the action done at 100 of them. 2) Do it whenever you pass a marker rather than saving it for one sweep; the count builds quietly in the background of a normal playthrough. 3) The name's casing (WAiNKer) is exactly as the platform list serves it. Requirements: WAiNK locations unlocked as areas open. Effort: A background grind across the whole game, or a deliberate sweep of a few hours. Basis: official description per Exophase (PSN data), list cross-checked on XCT.live and TrueAchievements.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Method: 1) Challenges are the short scored tasks scattered through the activity layer. 2) Complete any 50 - they do not need to be gold, just finished. 3) Clear them opportunistically while touring for races and stunts; the count reaches 50 quickly once you stop skipping markers. Requirements: Challenge markers across the map. Effort: A few hours woven into the activity sweep. Basis: official description per Exophase (PSN data), list cross-checked on XCT.live and TrueAchievements.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Method: 1) With your partner beside you, raise a wanted level to 4 stars - a loud crime in view of the police does it. 2) Break line of sight and get somewhere the search does not reach: alleys, rooftops, the water, anywhere off the road grid. 3) Stay unspotted until the stars drain completely - the trophy pops when the level is fully lost, with your partner still with you. Requirements: Your partner present; a vehicle helps reach cover. Effort: Minutes per attempt - the fiddly part is keeping your partner close. Basis: official description per Exophase (PSN data), list cross-checked on XCT.live and TrueAchievements.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Method: 1) Plan a route of 3 shops close together before you start - travel time is the enemy. 2) Rob the first with your partner present, keep the wanted level alive, and drive straight to the second, then the third. 3) The chain breaks if the wanted level fully drains, so keep pressure on: stay visible enough between shops. The trophy pops on the third robbery with the chain intact. Requirements: Your partner present; a fast car; 3 shops in one neighbourhood. Effort: A few attempts to route it cleanly. Basis: official description per Exophase (PSN data), list cross-checked on XCT.live and TrueAchievements.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Method: 1) A vehicle is discovered the first time you get in and drive it. 2) Treat every new model you see as a trophy in waiting - car parks, docks and rich neighbourhoods are showrooms. 3) Rare models spawn in specific districts and weather; if the count stalls, tour a district you have not cruised. Requirements: Nothing but curiosity and the open map. Effort: Mostly passive across a playthrough; a deliberate sweep finishes it in an evening. Basis: official description per Exophase (PSN data), list cross-checked on XCT.live and TrueAchievements.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Method: 1) Save Combat Focus for a packed room or a clustered patrol - you need 5 enemies inside one activation. 2) Line up headshots before you trigger it; the clock is generous but not kind. 3) Gang hideouts and the denser story firefights are the natural spots. If a run ends at 4, reposition rather than forcing it - the next cluster is never far. Requirements: Combat Focus unlocked in the story. Effort: Minutes once you stop spending Focus on single targets. Basis: official description per Exophase (PSN data), list cross-checked on XCT.live and TrueAchievements.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Method: 1) VCIA is Vice City International Airport - get onto the airfield side, past the fences or through a gate. 2) Take an aircraft that was never yours to take and get it off the ground - that is the unscheduled departure the description means. 3) The trophy pops once you are airborne and away. Expect a wanted level for the theft; you do not need to escape it, just to depart. Requirements: Airport access from the road; a plane on the apron. Effort: One brazen airport run. Basis: official description per Exophase (PSN data), reading of the description cross-checked against the list on XCT.live.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Method: METHOD UNCONFIRMED - no verified unlock method exists yet, and this guide invents none. The reading: A Rhino is the army's tank, and 'kinda hot in these Rhinos' reads like a line said from inside one - the likely trigger is getting into a Rhino, with surviving a fight against one as the other live candidate. Play it safe: the first time a Rhino appears, cover both readings in one encounter - engage and destroy one if the game throws it at you, and if any prompt or opening lets you climb in, take the seat before you finish it off. What confirms it: the first verified unlock reports after launch - watch the earn-rate trackers; when a method is confirmed, this entry's status flips from reading to method. Requirements: A Rhino encounter, which the story or a high wanted level eventually forces. Effort: One encounter, whenever the game schedules it. Basis: unconfirmed status per Output Lag (no confirmed method at launch); official description per Exophase (PSN data).

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Method: 1) Pick a jewelry store and go in quiet - no wanted level, no weapon on show. 2) Clear the cases without triggering the alarm or a witness call; slow and empty-handed-looking beats fast and obvious. 3) Walk out and get clear before you run - detection on the way out still counts. If a run goes loud, leave, let the area cool down and start again; the stores reset. Requirements: A jewelry store in an open district. Effort: A few patient attempts. Basis: official description per Exophase (PSN data), list cross-checked on XCT.live and TrueAchievements.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Method: 1) Bank vaults are robbable locations - plan each one: entry, the vault, an exit route and a fast car facing the right way. 2) The robbery only counts when you escape, so the getaway is the real objective; lose the heat or reach the cutoff clean. 3) Five different vaults bank the silver - repeats of the same vault are money, not progress. Requirements: Banks unlocked across the map; a crew or partner helps but is not required. Effort: Five planned robberies - an evening of work. Basis: official description per Exophase (PSN data), spelling as served on the platform list (an early editorial copy printed 'Withdrawl' - the platform wins), cross-checked on XCT.live.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Method: 1) Armored trucks run routes in free roam - shadow one or ambush it at a stop. 2) Crack it open (the rear doors are the weak point), take the cash, and go. 3) The trophy needs the escape as well as the robbery, so have the getaway planned before the first shot. Requirements: A heavy weapon or explosives for the doors; a fast escape car. Effort: One clean ambush. Basis: official description per Exophase (PSN data), list cross-checked on XCT.live and TrueAchievements.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Method: 1) Leonida has 52 areas, and an area counts as explored when you have actually been there, not when the map merely shows it. 2) Tour the state region by region - the last holdouts are usually small islands, inlets and the far corners of the map. 3) A boat and a plane both earn their keep here; some areas are only reachable by water or air. Requirements: The whole map open, which the story delivers by its end. Effort: A long, pleasant tour - hours if done as one sweep. Basis: official description per Exophase (PSN data), list cross-checked on XCT.live and TrueAchievements.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Method: 1) Nine gangs run illegal operations across the state - stash houses, fronts and depots. 2) Rob one operation belonging to each gang; the same gang twice is profit, not progress. 3) Keep a list as you go - this tracker cannot tell the gangs apart for you, but the map's territory shading can. Requirements: Operations found across the map; expect a fight at each. Effort: Nine robberies spread over the state. Basis: official description per Exophase (PSN data), list cross-checked on XCT.live and TrueAchievements.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Method: METHOD UNCONFIRMED - no verified unlock method exists yet, and this guide invents none. The name prints with a real ellipsis character, exactly as the platform list serves it. The reading: The description is unusually specific - a cocktail, a view, Ocean Beach - which points to one particular bar or terrace interaction on Ocean Beach rather than drinking anywhere. Play it safe: work the Ocean Beach strip deliberately - buy a cocktail at each beachfront bar, take it to the terrace or railing with the sea view, and linger a moment instead of drinking and sprinting off. What confirms it: the first verified unlock reports after launch, which should name the exact spot; until then this stays a reading, not a method. Requirements: Ocean Beach access and a few dollars for drinks. Effort: One slow evening on the strip. Basis: unconfirmed status per Output Lag (no confirmed method at launch); official description per Exophase (PSN data).

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Method: METHOD UNCONFIRMED - no verified unlock method exists yet, and this guide invents none. The reading: 'smash your way out of a vehicle showroom' is close to a literal instruction - sit in a showroom car and leave through the glass instead of the door, 'in classic style' nodding at the series' oldest trick. Play it safe: at any vehicle showroom, get into a display car and drive out through the front windows rather than reversing out politely; if one showroom does not pop it, try the next - the trigger may be tied to a particular one. What confirms it: the first verified unlock reports after launch. Requirements: A vehicle showroom with display cars. Effort: Minutes, once you are standing in one. Basis: unconfirmed status per Output Lag (no confirmed method at launch); official description per Exophase (PSN data).

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Method: 1) Go to the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley - the description names the place outright. 2) Bowl a full game there; 'follow-through' is bowling's own word for the delivery, so finish your frames rather than quitting mid-game. 3) If a full game does not pop it, bowl a second with your partner along - some alley triggers want company. The reading: The unlock almost certainly lives inside that alley; what is not yet pinned down is whether one game, one strike, or one partner game is the exact trigger, so the full game covers the honest readings. Play it safe: finish complete games at that specific alley, not quick frames elsewhere. What confirms it: verified unlock reports naming the trigger. Requirements: The alley open in free roam. Effort: One or two games of bowling. Basis: official description per Exophase (PSN data); the alley's listing and the unconfirmed trigger per Output Lag's list notes.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Method: 1) This one is bound to its description: a partnership - you and your partner character - with 'mass appeal'. 2) Play the partner activities together (the paired robberies, escapes and races elsewhere in this guide) and keep the partnership active rather than soloing the same content. 3) The reading is that a shared milestone - a joint record or a popularity-style threshold reached together - is what pops it; the paired trophies Hot Together and Retail Therapy are the natural places it would surface. Play it safe: default to doing free-roam feats with your partner present, so whichever shared trigger it is, you are standing next to them when it fires. What confirms it: verified unlock reports naming the actual trigger. Requirements: Your partner available in free roam. Effort: Passive if you already play paired; a mystery until the trigger is confirmed. Basis: description per Exophase (PSN data) and Output Lag's list notes; no confirmed method at launch.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Method: 1) The game tracks the choices you make - the platform counter runs to 500 - across dialogue, missions and free-roam decisions. 2) Play the story and make your choices deliberately rather than skipping through them; the count accumulates across a normal playthrough. 3) The trophy's short name is the platform's own - an early editorial copy added 'Than Words', and the platform list wins. The reading: At 500 tracked choices this is a volume trophy, not a single dramatic decision, so it should fall out of a full completion run on its own. Play it safe: if you are chasing it directly, keep choosing in every optional interaction instead of defaulting past them. What confirms it: the counter behaviour in verified unlock reports. Requirements: Nothing but playing and choosing. Effort: A full playthrough's worth of decisions. Basis: description per Exophase (PSN data), short-form name per XCT.live and Output Lag against the editorial long form.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Method: METHOD UNCONFIRMED - no verified unlock method exists yet, and this guide invents none. The reading: 'second time's the charm' points at succeeding at something on the immediate retry after a failure - a race re-run and won, a challenge beaten on the second attempt. Play it safe: build the habit now - whenever you fail a race, challenge or activity, retry it at once and win the second attempt, rather than moving on and returning later. That habit covers the natural readings at zero extra cost. What confirms it: the first verified unlock reports after launch, which should name what was retried. Requirements: Only the habit of instant retries. Effort: Nothing beyond how you already play. Basis: unconfirmed status per Output Lag (no confirmed method at launch); official description per Exophase (PSN data).

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Method: METHOD UNCONFIRMED - no verified unlock method exists yet, and this guide invents none. The reading: The name and the baffled description point at witnessing something strange - an unexplained event out in the state, the kind of thing you stumble on rather than schedule. Play it safe: explore off the roads, especially at night and in the remote areas the exploration sweep sends you to anyway, and when something odd happens - strange lights, a weird encounter - stay and watch it play out instead of driving on. What confirms it: the first verified unlock reports after launch, which should pin down what the event is. Requirements: Free-roam exploration; no known trigger. Effort: Luck, helped by wandering. Basis: unconfirmed status per Output Lag (no confirmed method at launch); official description per Exophase (PSN data).

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Method: METHOD UNCONFIRMED - no verified unlock method exists yet, and this guide invents none. The reading: The description is nearly literal - knock a pedestrian down ('bowl 'em over', ten-pin style) with a melee attack delivered from a moving vehicle, the drive-by melee swing. Play it safe: When you pass pedestrians at low speed on a bike or in a car, throw the melee swing as you pass; do it a handful of times in a row on a busy pavement and you have covered the reading whether the trigger is one victim or several. What confirms it: The first verified unlock reports after launch. Requirements: A vehicle, a pavement, a conscience you can live with. Effort: Minutes of menace. Basis: unconfirmed status per Output Lag (no confirmed method at launch); official description per Exophase (PSN data).

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Method: 1) Marked Bills come from robberies - cash that needs cleaning before it spends. 2) Run it through your laundering contacts rather than sitting on it; the trophy counts the laundered total, not your balance. 3) Keep the pipeline moving while you do the robbery layer of step 6 and the quarter-million arrives without a dedicated grind. Requirements: Laundering contacts unlocked through the story and strands. Effort: A background economy trophy across the robbery sweep. Basis: official description per Exophase (PSN data), list cross-checked on XCT.live and TrueAchievements.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Method: 1) Spend money in shops - clothes, weapons, vehicle work, anything with a till. 2) The counter is cumulative across all shops and all purchases, so nothing needs saving up or spending in one place. 3) It pops on its own in any playthrough that gears up properly; if you are short late, the vehicle shops will happily take the difference. Requirements: Money, which the robbery layer provides. Effort: Passive across the game. Basis: official description per Exophase (PSN data), list cross-checked on XCT.live and TrueAchievements.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Method: 1) There are 8 garage properties for sale across Leonida - buy every one. 2) They unlock as areas and funds allow; the expensive ones wait for the robbery money of step 6. 3) The trophy pops on the eighth purchase deed. Requirements: Serious cash - this is an endgame purchase list, not an early one. Effort: The earning takes longer than the buying. Basis: official description per Exophase (PSN data), list cross-checked on XCT.live and TrueAchievements.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Method: 1) The Scooter Bros app registers vehicles you bring to it - register 10 different ones. 2) Pair this with the Whip It Good discovery sweep: every new model you discover can be registered on the spot. 3) The trophy pops at the tenth registration. Requirements: The app unlocked; 10 vehicles worth registering. Effort: An hour of deliberate registering, less if paired with discoveries. Basis: official description per Exophase (PSN data), list cross-checked on XCT.live and TrueAchievements.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: Method: 1) Earn the other 54 trophies - this platinum has no method of its own. 2) Work the roadmap in order: story, strands, activities, the robbery layer, the sweeps, then the mysteries and the 100% gold. 3) When the last of the 54 pops, the price is paid and Vice is yours. Requirements: Everything else in this guide. Effort: The whole road - see A Long Road. Basis: official description per Exophase (PSN data), list cross-checked on XCT.live and TrueAchievements.
